prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good option to start with is **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters**, especially if you’re looking for a structured program for younger kids. It offers classes for **ages 4–6** and **7–12**, with an emphasis on focus, confidence, discipline, and basic self-defense. Its website currently advertises a **six-week introductory offer for $69**.

- **Address:** 6720 Mexico Rd, St. Peters, MO 63376  
- **Phone:** (636) 556-5271  
- [Classes and details](https://www.atastpeters.com/our-classes)

If your child is more interested in grappling, **Revive Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu** is another local option with kids’ classes and a family-focused approach: **1278 Jungermann Rd, Suite A; (636) 344-9334**. For taekwondo, **World Martial Arts Academy** lists youth classes for ages 6–17 at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd; (636) 928-0001**.

I’d try a class at one or two schools before committing. Ask about instructor experience with your child’s age, how they supervise partner drills, and the full cost after any introductory offer.
